summary: LightListen — first-iteration full-stack test. Backend: 46/46 pytest cases pass across auth, catalog, library, community requests, admin security matrix, admin content pipeline (novel→volume→chapter→publish→public list, edit/unpublish/delete cascade, cover upload, chapter update, users list+detail, request moderation) and media 404. Frontend (Expo web preview, mobile viewport 390x844): auth (signup/login, invalid login error toast, logout), Home (wordmark, avatar→profile, New this week, Popular now, Community requests banner, Continue listening after playback), Explore (search Star/Ayaka/Hoshi, single-row genre chips, filter+clear, empty state for nonsense query), Novel detail (hero, stats, save toggle, read-more, play CTA opens player), Player (scrubber, prev/next, ±15/30, speed sheet 1.5x, sleep sheet 30, chapter switch sheet, close returns keeping mini-player), Mini-player persistent on Home/Explore/Library/Novel/Requests/Profile and hidden on /player, tap opens /player, Library tabs (Continue resume, Saved empty, Downloads native-only empty state + Manage storage), Requests (create no-existing-request card, submit, appears in list with Requested badge + Yours, idempotent vote, My activity, search), Profile (name/email, theme switch Bookish/Cinematic/System recolours whole UI and persists across reload, Storage row → /downloads, Pro banner → /pro Coming soon + feature list, logout returns to login). All flows working. Two minor react-native-web console deprecation warnings observed: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — cosmetic only, no functional impact.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated shadow* style props (shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset). React Native Web logs deprecation: use `boxShadow` on web (or keep shadowColor/... plus a web-only boxShadow). Reference: /app/frontend/app/novel/[id].tsx:394-399
Uses deprecated `pointerEvents` prop on <Animated.View>. React Native Web logs: `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents`. Reference: /app/frontend/app/novel/[id].tsx:163

action_items: (Minor) Migrate shadow* props to boxShadow in /app/frontend/app/novel/[id].tsx artWrap style to silence RN-Web deprecation warning.
(Minor) Move `pointerEvents="none"` from prop to `style.pointerEvents` on the Animated.View sticky header in /app/frontend/app/novel/[id].tsx to silence RN-Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1249 lines — approaching the >700 line threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth, catalog, library, requests, admin, media) for maintainability. Not blocking for MVP.

In POST /api/requests, an unauthenticated user hitting a duplicate title path still requires auth (Depends(current_user)) — good. Duplicate detection uses case-insensitive regex on the full string which is correct.
Admin dependency correctly requires BOTH X-Admin-Key AND role=admin AND valid access JWT — matrix verified (no-JWT→401, wrong-key→403, non-admin+correct-key→403, admin+correct-key→200).
Chapter creation accepts audio_url OR uploaded file with clean 400 when neither provided — verified.
Media endpoint handles Range header with 206 + Content-Range (code path verified; live storage 404 verified). No _id leaks in any response (all outputs stringify _id via helpers).
Password max_length=72 in Pydantic + explicit UTF-8 byte check in hash_password guards bcrypt's 72-byte limit — good.
reader@lightlisten.app is NOT auto-seeded — first-run tests must signup. This is documented in test_credentials.md but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: reader@lightlisten.app test user is auto-created via signup on first test run. Several TEST_-prefixed community requests were created during testing. One TEST_AdminNovel was fully created/published/unpublished/deleted by the admin pipeline test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL is https://ln-player-app.preview.emergentagent.com (from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL); the URL in the review request is stale. Pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs like `.test` — use @example.com for synthetic emails. Backend lowercases email on signup/login — assert against email.lower(). Admin auth needs BOTH `Authorization: Bearer <admin_access>` AND `X-Admin-Key`. For multipart chapter creation, remove Content-Type from admin_headers so `requests` can set the multipart boundary. Mini-player is present when a track is active and hidden on `/player` and the (auth) group. Downloads are intentionally web-unsupported (empty state).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no issues surfaced. Only two cosmetic RN-Web deprecation warnings reported.
